name: reverse-pmos
title: Reverse-polarity protection with a P-MOSFET
about: AO3401A in the supply path: drain at the input, source at the output, gate to ground through 10 kΩ. It conducts with milliohms instead of a diode drop; with a reversed source the gate is above the source and the body diode blocks. For inputs up to about 10 V (VGS max ±12 V).
notes: Graph: the connector that feeds 'in' gets "source": "reversible".
Above about 10 V input: a zener (10 V) from gate to source and a larger gate resistor, so that VGS stays below 12 V.
AO3401A: 3.2 A at 70 °C, 60 mΩ at VGS -4.5 V; edakit sim checks current and power (LIM).
